scope: Copied measured archive, archived runtime sources/provenance, and separate synthetic files; no original files modified.
content_checks: Literal password, client-secret, API-key, and access/refresh-token assignments
structured_checks: Sensitive environment-variable names with literal values
Nested JSON and embedded JSON string objects
limitation: Heuristic scans provide evidence for this review; they do not prove the absence of every possible credential format.
